facts.note: States that when the temple bell struck nine, his watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and that his uncle made a scene about it in front of everyone.
States he went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
States the thump above him in the atelier at 10:18 by his watch, then the repeater: ten slow deep notes he counted, then doubled notes, then quick high ones he did not count.
States someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 by his watch, and someone came quickly down at 10:21 by his watch; he did not see who and the door was shut.
States Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32 by his watch and they sat together until the temple struck eleven.
